message.content:
Compose personal messages to my friends as if I wrote them, without any mention of AI assistance.

Example (several paragraphs, matching the meaning of the negated text):

Hey Maya,

I’ve been thinking about you and wanted to check in. How have you been doing lately? I know things have been busy, but I’d love to hear what you’ve been up to—work, life, anything. If you’re free sometime this week, maybe we could grab coffee or take a walk and catch up properly.

Also, I wanted to say I really appreciate you. You’ve always been the kind of friend who shows up and listens, and it means a lot to me. I’m trying to be more intentional about staying connected with the people I care about, and you’re definitely one of them.

No pressure to reply right away—just wanted to send a little hello. Let me know what days might work for you, and we’ll find something that fits.

Talk soon,  
[Your Name]
